SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.UnitPrice * oi.Quantity * (1 - oi.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID), 2) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.OrderID = o.OrderID
JOIN products p ON oi.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE (o.OrderDate BETWEWEN '1997-12-01' AND '1997-12-31')

SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.UnitPrice * oi.Quantity * (1 - oi.Discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.UnitPrice * oi.Quantity * (1 - oi.Discount)), 2) AS TotalRevenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID
JOIN products p ON oi.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID
WHERE c.Name = 'Beverages' AND o.OrderDate BETWEDIR 1997-06-01 AND 1997-06-30

SELECT customers.customer_name, SUM((products.UnitPrice - COALESCE(costs.average_cost, products.UnitPrice * 0.7)) * oi.Quantity * (1 - oi.Discount)) AS margin 
 FROM order_items oi 
 JOIN orders ON oi.order_id = orders.id 
 JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id 
 LEFT JOIN products ON oi.product_id = products.id 
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT category, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_cost FROM product_categories GROUP BY category) costs ON products.category_id = costs.category_id 
 WHERE orders.order_date BETWEDIR '1997-06-01' AND order_date <= '1997-06-30'
 GROUP BY customers.customer_name 
 ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 1
